name: OpenVibe.Help

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the database is what ready checks)

resumes.what: sign-in sessions are rows in the database, so a person stays signed in across the restart; nothing runs in the background that a restart could leave half done
OpenVibe.Events redelivers network.account.export_requested and network.account.deleted that were pending during the stop (at least once; account_data_events applies each export and deletion once)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart; manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: migrations 0001-0002 only create Help's own tables; an earlier release has none to read

leases.none: no claims: one process serves the site

notes: Port 5020, unit openvibe-help.service. The network's help centre: a catalog of every OpenVibe product site built from openvibe-contracts (each site's state, one line, pillars and FAQ), articles generated from it, search across them, and support tickets a signed-in person opens and staff answer (staff judged by the Network role claim). Consumes OpenVibe.Network (SSO with PKCE S256 as OAuth client help, JWKS). Owns help_tickets and help_messages. No capabilities yet: tickets are a person's own, not an app's.

site.name: Help
site.what: Every OpenVibe site in one help centre: what each one does, its common questions, and a ticket to a person when the answer is not there.
